- d13147e3 feat(proposition): SemanticGraph[O <: GraphOrder] and one private CompareCore. ChartCompatibility.compare delegates with its signature unchanged. SemanticProjection.canonical is gloss-aware and exact, and refuses with CanonicalBudgetExhausted instead of an id fallback. sourceOrder is private[storymodel4s] and is for the S2a-2 shims. Default Canonical checksum unchanged: a pin captured on a base export before identity.scala changed still matches.
- 02b96bf9 test: the cold review's findings, measured (below).

GATE (LocallyObserved, JVM, fatal warnings, reference-scope set of 24 modules, fmt last) at d13147e3: 24 test tasks, 3334 passed / 0 failed / 5 skipped, GATE_EXIT=0. At 02b96bf9, scoped: propositionJVM 69 passed plus 8 align parity pins, fmt clean. JS/Native NOT run: #16 is held until about lease 1790187869425.
MUTANTS S1-S8, all killed. S5 (sourceOrder reverses relations) SURVIVED the generated parity property; a fixed fixture now kills it. Details are in the d13147e3 message.

COLD REVIEW (fresh-context agent): GO with follow-ups. The refactor preserves historical output and the forge doors hold. It found:
1. MEASUREMENT VALIDITY. CompareCore still breaks head and greedy-relation ties by view order, and canonical order is a SHA colour order that also reads focus. The strict score therefore moves with focus, and with an unmatched lemma (cat vs feline). Both now RUN as named expected failures. Filed as S2a-1b bd-01M37EKWYZ1973TGK7JSTZC28C, P1, which blocks S2a-3 (strict wiring), so no strict profile can consume this. S2a-1 itself wires nothing strict.
2. CORRECTION of my seq 799: "the ConceptId tie-break never reaches gate flags" is FALSE in general. A new teeth test shows the chart path's ids choosing polarityConflict vs roleReversal on a head tie. There is a git note on d13147e3, and the S2a-0 doc is fixed.

Proposal: land 8e3b9090 + d13147e3 + 02b96bf9 after the JS/Native half, which I will run when #16 frees, unless your integration gate covers it. S2a-1b next: an order-free tie rule (optimal assignment or max over ties) needs an ADR line. Do you want to decide it, or shall I draft?
